title: Most people say they follow Jesus…
paragraphs: Most people say they follow Jesus…
But their life looks exactly the same.

No surrender.
No sacrifice.
No real obedience.
And deep down—you know it.
“The Price of True Discipleship (No One Talks About This)”
This is not another feel-good Christian read.

This book will confront the version of Christianity
that requires nothing… and produces nothing.
Because Jesus never called you to comfort.
He called you to carry your cross.
🔥 WHAT THIS BOOK WILL DO IN YOU

• Expose the lie of “easy Christianity”
• Show you what Jesus actually meant by “follow Me”
• Break the grip of hidden compromise
• Teach you how to deny yourself daily (for real)
• Help you walk in obedience—even when it costs you
• Shift you from passive believer → real disciple
⚔️ HERE’S THE TRUTH MOST WON’T SAY

Most people want Jesus as Savior.
Few accept Him as Lord.

Most want blessings.
Few want transformation.

Most avoid the narrow road.
Few walk it—no matter the cost.
So where do you stand?
🔒 THIS IS NOT FOR EVERYONE
This book is only available to those inside the
Why?
Because this isn’t content.
This is training.

A growing vault designed to:
• Build real disciples
• Break spiritual stagnation
• Strengthen obedience
• Transform your daily walk with God
⚡ THIS IS YOUR MOMENT

If you feel convicted reading this…
that’s not guilt.
That’s God calling you higher.
You can keep playing comfortable Christianity…
Or you can step into real discipleship.

Become the believer who doesn’t just talk about faith—
but lives it.
💬 ENGAGE + ACT
